en: The front side of the postcard shows a hand-colored image of a harbor cityscape labeled 'Sundsvall. Hamnen.' with boats, water, and classic European buildings along the water's edge. The reverse side is filled with handwritten Swedish text, features a green Swedish stamp valued at 5 öre, a clear circular postmark (SUN...), and addresses the postcard to Tomas Gralin at Klostergatan in Jönköping.
